Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.The RoleWe are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.What You’ll Do- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.What We’re Looking For- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.What We Offer- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.katharina@hey-germany.com (https://mailto:katharina@hey-germany.com)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.Create impact with passion!For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for aHead of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.Responsibilities1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio4. NPI & Industrialization- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves5. Cross-functional Collaboration- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection6. Financial & Resource Management- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates7. Transformation & Change Leadership- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery8. Governance, Risk & Compliance- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigationYour ProfileProfessional Experience- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)Intercultural Experience- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisitePersonal attributes- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talentErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Aufsicht, Leitung, Projektmanagement

At the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law, scholars pursue research relating to fundamental issues and current developments in the areas of public international law, European Union law, and the constitutional and administrative law of individual states, together with numerous visiting scholars from all over the world. In its fields, our library is the largest in Europe and one of the most comprehensive in the world.The newly established Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER), headed by Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg, invites applications for twoResearch Fellow positions (Doctoral Researchers) (x/f/m)with a preferred starting date of 1 January 2027 (the positions are funded for three years)The Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER) investigates how global order is transformed as states - particularly great and middle powers - pursue competing visions of the principles, rules and institutions that structure international relations amid intensifying geopolitical rivalry. The group conceptualizes these processes as constellations of global (dis)ordering through which states seek to advance their visions of order by creating, reshaping, connecting, bypassing, or disengaging from international institutions, building new formal or ad hoc institutional arrangements, and strategically leveraging economic and technological interdependence. DISORDER examines how such constellations emerge across the fields of security, economy, and technology, and what forms of global order they produce, transform, or erode.Job descriptionThe successful candidates will develop independent doctoral dissertation projects within the framework of the Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER). Their research should contribute to the group’s broader inquiry into how states pursue competing visions of global order through international institutions and how these processes reshape global order across different issue areas.Possible orientations of the doctoral projects include:- an actor-centred perspective, examining how a particular great or middle power pursues its vision of global order across different issue areas institutional settings; or- a domain-centred perspective, comparing how different states interact with and reshape international institutions within a particular field, such as security, economy, or technology.Potential empirical cases may include, but are not limited to, the United States, China, Russia, India, Brazil, Japan, and other international actors such as the European Union.The doctoral researchers will:- develop and conduct an original PhD project that contributes to the conceptual and empirical agenda of the DISORDER research group;- conduct research activities of the group;- participate in research group meetings, workshops, conferences, and other academic activities;- present research findings at international conferences and prepare publications for peer-reviewed academic outlets;- contribute to the organization of workshops, conferences, and other activities of the research group and the MPIL.Your profile- An excellent Master’s
